queries.name: componentes_insumos_por_codigo
queries.sql:
WITH insumos AS (
    SELECT ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
       r.SystemType,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias IS NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_insumo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias = 1
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_unica,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i.coincidencias > 1
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coincidencia_ambigua
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN insumos i
  ON i.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType
ORDER BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType

queries.name: cobertura_codigos_componentes
queries.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
       SystemType,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ComponenteCodigoFuente)
           AS codigos_distintos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(ComponenteCodigoFuente)) = ''
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS codigos_vacios,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS activos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS inactivos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS activo_desconocido
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

queries.name: productos_padre_sin_match
queries.sql:
WITH productos AS (
    SELECT ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS coincidencias
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
)
SELECT TOP (100)
       CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
       r.SystemType,
       r.ProductoCodigoFuente,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes_sin_producto,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.Activo = 1
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.Activo = 0
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inactivos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.Activo IS NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS estado_desconocido
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN productos p
  ON p.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND p.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND p.CodigoFuente = r.ProductoCodigoFuente
WHERE p.coincidencias IS NULL
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType, r.ProductoCodigoFuente
ORDER BY componentes_sin_producto DESC,
         r.SystemType, r.ProductoCodigoFuente

queries.name: insumos_actividad_y_costos
queries.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
       SystemType,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS insumos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS activos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS inactivos,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Activo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS estado_desconocido,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Costo IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           AS con_costo,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CostoPromedio IS NOT NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_costo_promedio,
       SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoCosto IS NOT NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_ultimo_costo
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

queries.name: integridad_costos_recetas
queries.sql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
       SystemType,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario IS NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_costo_unitario,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CostoTotal IS NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_costo_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario = 0
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_unitario_cero,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CostoTotal = 0
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_total_cero,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Cantidad <= 0
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cantidad_no_positiva
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

queries.name: insumos_codigos_duplicados
queries.sql:
WITH duplicados AS (
    SELECT ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente,
           COUNT_BIG(*) AS registros
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
    HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1
)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
       SystemType,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS codigos_duplicados,
       SUM(registros) AS registros_implicados
FROM duplicados
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

objective: Diagnosticar vinculacion de componentes de recetas con insumos por claves de origen, faltantes de productos y estado de actividad. Solo lectura.
